dict.string: LangReadr listens when you tap the microphone in a chat, to write what you say into your message. What you say stays on this device.
LangReadr writes what you say into your message when you tap the microphone in a chat. Your speech is recognized on this device and isn't sent anywhere.
LangReadr opens the camera when you choose to take a photo to add to a chat. The photo stays on this device.
LangReadr shows your recent photos when you add to a chat, so you can attach one. Only the photos you attach are used, and they stay on this device.
